$comment: Offline interoperability fixtures (COR-486, R5). Each file is pinned by SHA-256; a mismatch fails the suites that read this manifest. Nothing here is fetched at test time. 'disposition' is the import preflight outcome: cinder-envelope, dtcg-document, unsupported-profile or invalid.
